title: Tartlet Savory Delights
description: A delightful combination of creamy, savory, and cheese, all wrapped in a crispy tartlet. Perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.

ingredients.name: Savory Herb Mix
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup (chopped fresh parsley, dill, and chives)

instructions: Place tartlet shells on a baking sheet.
Spoon a small amount of creamy cheese spread into each shell.
Sprinkle a pinch of savory herb mix over the cheese.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the shells are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
